info.title: VETNEX API
info.description:
VETNEX veterinary practice management API.

Every tenant-owned query is scoped to the organisation resolved from the session; no
endpoint accepts an organisation id from the caller. Request bodies are generated from
the Zod contracts in `packages/shared`, which the server validates with.

Errors always use the `ErrorEnvelope` shape. Authentication is a session cookie for
browsers or a bearer token for server clients.

servers.description: Same-origin proxy exposed by the web app

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Signup, sign-in, sessions, password reset, invitations.

get.summary: Page through the append-only audit trail
get.description: Newest first. The trail can only be read: there is no update or delete route anywhere in the API.

post.summary: Accept an invitation and start a session
Sign in with email and password
post.description: Returns `409 ORGANISATION_SELECTION_REQUIRED` with `practices[]` when the account belongs to more than one practice and `organisationId` was not supplied. Unknown emails, wrong passwords and disabled accounts are indistinguishable.
Always reports success so the endpoint cannot be used to discover which emails exist. In development the token is returned as `devToken` because no email provider is configured.

post.summary: Reset a password with a token
post.description: Revokes every existing session for the account.

get.description: Returns the `SessionPayload`, or the literal JSON value `null` when signed out.

delete.summary: Revoke one of the caller's sessions

post.summary: Create a practice, its first clinic and the owner account
post.description: Creates the organisation, first clinic, departments, the five system roles and a session. Validates with `signupSchema`.

devToken.description: Development only. Present when AUTH_DEV_TOKEN_DELIVERY=true because no email provider is configured; never returned in production.

permissions.description: Active permission codes granted by the role.

ValidationFailed.description: The request body or query did not validate.

Unauthenticated.description: No valid session cookie or bearer token.

Forbidden.description: The caller lacks the required permission, or the origin is untrusted.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist in the caller's organisation.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with existing state.
